findings: The blade source, STEP, and STL changed from the rejected bytes; its envelope changed from upright 14.7 by 14 by 36.998 mm to low-profile 36.998 by 14 by 14.7 mm with a vertical trunnion axis.
All nine exact family STLs independently passed mesh, 210 by 210 by 220 mm bed, and 0.80 mm sampled-thickness gates.
An independent 45-degree recomputation matched the sealed support report and exact STL hashes for all nine families, including both tray lips and the magazine tongue.
limits: The triangle-normal audit is not a slicer run or generated toolpath.
No successful print, support accessibility/removal, surface quality, adhesion, warping, bed-origin/brim fit, dimensional compensation, physical fit, durability, or human play was tested.
The largest tray has only 4 mm total nominal margin on the tight bed axis.
